verdict.rationale: Direct probes confirm a live llms.txt index at docs.helicone.ai/llms.txt. Doc pages are also served as raw .md files that point agents to that index, many cited docs URLs use the .md form, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (swagger.json) is available. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on pointing agents at these docs.
